title: Contrastive Focus with No ... Sino
goal: Refute misconceptions and articulate contrastive focus using 'no... sino' and 'sino que' in formal argumentative prose.

items: Correct an assumption with 'no ... sino' and give the right alternative.
Choose between 'sino' and 'sino que' when I correct something.
Build contrastive cleft sentences such as 'No fue X, sino Y lo que ...'.
Soften a correction with 'sino más bien'.
